demo.mp4.command: media/.venv/bin/python media/video.py && ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i media/frames/%05d.png -c:v libx264 -crf 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p media/master/demo.mp4 && ffmpeg -i media/master/demo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart media/demo.mp4
demo.mp4.shows: Replay of the real UART transcript (typed pace from the capture timestamps), then the crc-poly mutant session with the oracle-divergent responses highlighted against the expected lines, then the verdicts. 1920x1080 30 fps H.264; lossless master in media/master/ (git-ignored).

loop.png.shows: Mutant x gate matrix: examples/good plus the 14 single-edit mutants against all 8 gates. Red cells carry the gate's measured detail (e.g. '5/46 wrong'); the amber row is the build-only kill. Footer: the replayed fix sequence and the 14/14 kill rate.

result.png.shows: Left: the real UART0 transcript of examples/good booting in QEMU lm3s6965evb (banner + scripted shell session; elided lines marked). Right: the 8 judge gates with measured values and the maps_ok 8192 B pass line; flash/SRAM usage from the linker map.
